title: Node.js
focus: JavaScript and Node.js from the ground up, by hand: language fundamentals, functions and closures, async, Node core modules, HTTP without frameworks, errors and testing, then data structures, algorithms and backend design at big tech interview level.
ladder: The very basics: variables, operators, if and else, for loops, tiny functions
Strings, arrays and objects by hand
Functions, closures, recursion, higher order functions
Async: callbacks, promises, async/await, timers, errors
Node core: fs, path, events, streams, buffers
HTTP without frameworks: routing, JSON, validation, status codes
Testing, debugging and error handling patterns
Data structures and algorithms: hash maps, two pointers, stacks, queues, trees, graphs
Backend design at interview level: rate limiting, caching, queues, pagination
